entities.name: Smetona Authoritarian Era
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Antanas Smetona's coup (December 1926) and authoritarian nationalist rule. The 1938 ultimatum from Poland over Vilnius, the 1939 Klaipėda ultimatum from Nazi Germany, and the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact sealing Lithuania's fate. The brief 'return' of Vilnius from the USSR (1939).
